objective: Test whether exact structural results discovered in specialist Stage32 lanes can be transported, with all hypotheses preserved, into broad population-wide necessary conditions on the current authoritative FULL178/Picard64 population. Produce either an exact transferable adapter candidate or an exact no-generalization/blocker result without descending into ordinary terminal-by-terminal pruning.

initial_seed.theme: MB104 residual-character/Fourier and A1 square-energy structure
initial_seed.candidate_transport: general Picard64 character or energy lower bound visible from the FULL178 terminal/completion interface

owns: source-lane to FULL178/Picard64 semantic generalization feasibility
exact definition of transported invariants on the target completion space
minimization over hidden/free Picard64 completion coordinates and congruence constraints
proof of nontrivial target-visible lower bounds or exact cancellation/no-go
bounded identical-population diagnostics after a universal target condition is proved
retained source-locked adapter or blocker handoff for hostile audit and MAIN decision
does_not_own: EX5 Picard64 interface production or repair
178 ordinary FULL178 enumeration, prefix, maxcut, block transport, or local pruning
MAIN authority promotion, current-authority subtraction, overlap accounting, claim-DAG mutation, final integration, or merge

target_interfaces.known_interface_family: FULL178 terminal -> retained primitive Picard64 completion
target_interfaces.free_completion_issue: A terminal fixes only part of the selected64 pairing data; any bridge bound must hold after minimization over every allowed hidden/free completion unless a stronger exact adapter is proved.

nodes.title: Freeze source theorem/candidate and target population semantics
nodes.goal: Identify one exact source result, its source locks/audit status/hypotheses, and the exact current FULL178/Picard64 target semantics. Separate intrinsic quantities from source-specific packet data before attempting any transfer.

nodes.title: Define the transported character/invariant on general target completions
nodes.goal: Prove that the proposed source-lane character, Fourier direction, energy, or equivalent invariant is well-defined on every target object in the claimed scope. If source-specific hypotheses cannot be removed by proof, freeze NO_GENERALIZATION for that formulation.

nodes.title: Minimize over hidden/free completion coordinates
nodes.goal: Compute an exact lower bound over all allowed free Picard64 completions and congruence conditions. A useful bridge requires a nontrivial target-visible bound; complete cancellation is a valid exact no-go result.

nodes.title: Bounded identical-population diagnostic
nodes.goal: After a universal target condition is proved, test a bounded representative slice on exactly the same population semantics as the audited baseline. Measure strict gain only as noncredit diagnostic evidence.

nodes.title: Full-population adapter candidate or exact no-go
nodes.goal: Formulate a source-locked FULL178 adapter candidate only if the universal quantifiers and free-completion minimization are proved. Otherwise freeze the exact reason the route cannot generalize.

nodes.title: Retained hostile-audit handoff
nodes.goal: Freeze an exact transferable adapter candidate, an exact no-generalization theorem/blocker, or an upstream demand. Grant no MAIN pruning credit.
